partnership_announcements.description: Avalon Pharma signed a EUR 3 million contract with Adalvo Limited to secure exclusive rights to register, market, and distribute GLP1 products for weight loss and obesity in select Middle East and North Africa countries, with exclusivity in Saudi Arabia. The agreement includes potential for expansion to other GLP products and localized manufacturing.

product_launches.description: Avalon Pharma launched Co-pan, an innovative herbal cough syrup, in August 2024. The product is sugar-free and alcohol-free, targeting both adults and children, and aligns with Avalon Pharma's growth and innovation strategy in healthcare.

overview_description.description: Avalon Pharma manufactures topical preparations such as creams, lotions, other topical solutions, and cosmetic products. It produces disinfectants, sanitizers, mouthwashes, and a volume of hygiene products. They focus on developing products and formulations that will meet the needs and expectations of customers.
